activation_collect_dg_sound.statement:
\<lbrakk>routed_context S \<gamma>\<^sub>D\<^sub>G \<G> g analysis_global
          route bot0.0 s0d s0g sigma vars x0.0 sg seed resolve is_bot
          \<gamma>\<^sub>M R;
 (cfg_entry g, c\<^sub>0) \<in> vars;
 S0.0 \<subseteq> \<gamma>\<^sub>D\<^sub>G s0d s0g\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<A>\<^bsub>\<G>,R,c\<^sub>0,g,S0.0\<^esub> v ctx
                  \<subseteq> \<gamma>\<^sub>M (sg (Inl (v, ctx)))
activation_collect_dg_sound.why: Main-statements appendix: a solved D/G table satisfies the coverage obligations.

activation_collect_sound.statement:
activation_coverage g S cover R c\<^sub>0 \<G> \<Longrightarrow>
\<A>\<^bsub>\<G>,R,c\<^sub>0,g,S\<^esub> v ctx \<subseteq> cover v ctx
activation_collect_sound.why: Main-statements appendix: the activation coverage theorem.

bfilter_sound.statement:
\<lbrakk>sound_refinement intersect aval_abs tobool inv_less inv_eq inv_plus
          inv_minus inv_times;
 s \<in> \<lbrakk>\<sigma>\<rbrakk>;
 truthy (\<lbrakk>e\<rbrakk>\<^sub>e s) = res\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> s \<in> \<lbrakk>sound_refinement.bfilter intersect
                                    aval_abs tobool inv_less inv_eq inv_plus
                                    inv_minus inv_times e res
                                    \<sigma>\<rbrakk>
bfilter_sound.why: Chapter 5, the guard filter drops no store that passes the guard.

compile.simps(4).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (Seq c1.0 c2.0) k n =
(let (n1, en1, E1, K1) =
       compile \<Pi> p c1.0 (Statement (n + csize c1.0)) n;
     (n2, en2, E2, K2) = compile \<Pi> p c2.0 k (n + csize c1.0)
 in (n2, en1, E1 \<union> E2, K1 \<union> K2))
compile.simps(4).why: Program-model chapter: compiling a sequence hands the first command the second's entry.

compile.simps(5).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (com.If b c1.0 c2.0) k n =
(let (n1, en1, E1, K1) = compile \<Pi> p c1.0 k (Suc n);
     (n2, en2, E2, K2) = compile \<Pi> p c2.0 k n1
 in (n2, Statement n,
     {(Statement n, EA_Assume b, if c1.0 = SKIP then k else en1),
      (Statement n, EA_AssumeNot b,
       if c2.0 = SKIP then k else en2)} \<union>
     (if c1.0 = SKIP then {} else E1) \<union>
     (if c2.0 = SKIP then {} else E2),
     K1 \<union> K2))
compile.simps(5).why: Program-model chapter: both branches of a conditional compile against one continuation.

compile.simps(6).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (While b c) k n =
(let (n1, en1, E1, K1) = compile \<Pi> p c (Statement n) (Suc n)
 in (n1, Statement n,
     {(Statement n, EA_Assume b, en1),
      (Statement n, EA_AssumeNot b, k)} \<union>
     E1,
     K1))
compile.simps(6).why: Program-model chapter: a loop body compiles against the loop head.

compile.simps(8).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (Return e) k n =
(Suc n, Statement n, {(Statement n, EA_Ret e p, FunctionResult p)}, {})
compile.simps(8).why: Program-model chapter: a return edge targets the procedure's result node.

csim_star.statement:
\<lbrakk>\<Pi>,g \<turnstile> (c, s, frs) \<approx> (v, t, stk);
 procs_embedded \<Pi> g; return_safe c;
 \<G>,\<Pi> \<turnstile> (c, s, frs) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 src'\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>cfg'.
                     \<G>,g \<turnstile>
                     (v, t, stk) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>c\<^sup>* cfg' \<and>
                     \<Pi>,g \<turnstile> src' \<approx> cfg'
csim_star.why: Main-statements appendix: simulation of source runs by the compiled graph.

csim_step.statement:
\<lbrakk>\<Pi>,g \<turnstile> (c, s, frs) \<approx> (v, t, stk);
 procs_embedded \<Pi> g; return_safe c;
 \<G>,\<Pi> \<turnstile> (c, s, frs) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p src'\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>cfg'.
                     \<G>,g \<turnstile>
                     (v, t, stk) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>c\<^sup>* cfg' \<and>
                     \<Pi>,g \<turnstile> src' \<approx> cfg'
csim_step.why: Program-model chapter: one source step is matched by the compiled graph.

cstep_preserves_activation_trace_repr.why: Chapter 4: one graph step is matched by a trace rule.

ls_channel_sound.statement:

\<Longrightarrow> eval_query.oracle_holds (ls_channel c x) s

mcp_combine_sound.statement:

 mcp_independent gcs; gcs \<noteq> []\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> sound_local_spec \<G> (mcp_gamma (map fst gcs))
                   (mcp_combine (map snd gcs))
mcp_combine_sound.why: Cooperation chapter: independent sound components combine into a sound component.

nv_source_certified.statement:
\<exists>res v stk.
   run_voblint nv_config nv_prog = Analysed res \<and>
   map (\<lambda>chk. (check_point chk, check_verdict chk))
    (report_checks res) =
   [(Statement 4, Decided Check_Proved),
    (Statement 5, Decided Check_Proved)] \<and>
   prog_table nv_prog,prog_cfg nv_prog \<turnstile>
   (Seq (Check (0, 0) (exp.Eq (V STR ''a'') (N 6)))
     (Check (0, 0) (exp.Eq (V STR ''b'') (N 5))),
    nv_final, []) \<approx>
   (v, nv_final, stk) \<and>
   nv_final
   \<in> \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
                      nv_prog,prog_cfg
                               nv_prog,cinit_stores
  (declared_global nv_prog)\<^esub>
          v \<and>
   nv_final \<in> \<lbrakk>res\<rbrakk>\<^bsub>v\<^esub> \<and>
   nv_final \<in> \<V>\<^bsub>res\<^esub> v
nv_source_certified.why: Non-vacuity section of the evaluation: the endpoint's premises hold for one program.

pstep.Call.why: Program-model chapter: the source step rule for a call.

pstep.RestoreStep.statement:
\<G>,\<Pi> \<turnstile>
(Restore, s, Frame fr dst # frs) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p
(SKIP, combine_assign dst (s ret_var) (combine_env \<G> fr s), frs)
pstep.RestoreStep.why: Program-model chapter: the source step rule that restores the caller's frame.

pstep.ReturnSome.statement:
\<G>,\<Pi> \<turnstile> (Return (Some e), s, frs) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p
(Unwind, s(ret_var := \<lbrakk>e\<rbrakk>\<^sub>e s), frs)
pstep.ReturnSome.why: Program-model chapter: the source step rule for returning a value.

pstep.UnwindAct.statement:
\<G>,\<Pi> \<turnstile>
(Seq Unwind Restore, s, Frame fr dst # frs) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p
(SKIP, combine_assign dst (s ret_var) (combine_env \<G> fr s), frs)
pstep.UnwindAct.why: Program-model chapter: the source step rule that pops the caller's frame after an explicit return.

run_voblint_arithmetic_safe.statement:
\<lbrakk>run_voblint config p = Analysed res;
 s \<in> \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
                      p,prog_cfg p,cinit_stores (declared_global p)\<^esub>
          v;
 \<forall>d\<in>set (report_diagnostics res).
    diagnostic_point d \<noteq> v\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> arithmetic_safe_at (prog_cfg p) v s
run_voblint_arithmetic_safe.why: Arithmetic-safety endpoint cited in the introduction.

run_voblint_check_sound.statement:
\<lbrakk>s0.0 \<in> cinit_stores (declared_global p);
 declared_global p,prog_table p \<turnstile>
 (main_body (prog_table p), s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 (residual, s, frs);
 next_check residual = Some (l, e);
 run_voblint config p = Analysed res\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>c\<in>set (report_checks res).
                     check_label c = l \<and>
                     check_exp c = e \<and>
                     s \<in> \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
    p,prog_cfg p,cinit_stores (declared_global p)\<^esub>
                              (check_point c) \<and>
                     check_verdict c \<noteq> Dead \<and>
                     (check_verdict c =
                      Decided Check_Proved \<longrightarrow>
                      truthy (\<lbrakk>e\<rbrakk>\<^sub>e s)) \<and>
                     (check_verdict c =
                      Decided Check_Refuted \<longrightarrow>
                      \<not> truthy (\<lbrakk>e\<rbrakk>\<^sub>e s))
run_voblint_check_sound.why: Check-verdict endpoint cited in the introduction.

run_voblint_dead_check_unreached.statement:
\<lbrakk>run_voblint config p = Analysed res;
 chk \<in> set (report_checks res); check_verdict chk = Dead\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
                               p,prog_cfg
                                  p,cinit_stores (declared_global p)\<^esub>
                   (check_point chk) =
                  {}
run_voblint_dead_check_unreached.why: Unreachability endpoint cited in the introduction.

run_voblint_report_contract.statement:
run_voblint config p = Analysed res \<Longrightarrow>
report_config res = config
run_voblint config p = Analysed res \<Longrightarrow>
report_cfg res = prog_cfg p
run_voblint config p = Analysed res \<Longrightarrow> well_formed_report res
run_voblint config p = Analysed res \<Longrightarrow> sound_report p res
run_voblint_report_contract.why: Results chapter: what an analysed answer guarantees about its report.

run_voblint_source_sound.statement:
\<lbrakk>s0.0 \<in> cinit_stores (declared_global p);
 declared_global p,prog_table p \<turnstile>
 (main_body (prog_table p), s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 (residual, s, frs);
 run_voblint config p = Analysed res\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>v stk.
                     prog_table p,prog_cfg p \<turnstile>
                     (residual, s, frs) \<approx> (v, s, stk) \<and>
                     s \<in> \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
    p,prog_cfg p,cinit_stores (declared_global p)\<^esub>
                              v \<and>
                     s \<in> \<lbrakk>res\<rbrakk>\<^bsub>v\<^esub> \<and>
                     s \<in> \<V>\<^bsub>res\<^esub> v
run_voblint_source_sound.why: The introduction states the source-level soundness result with its actual premises.

run_voblint_spine.statement:
\<lbrakk>s0.0 \<in> cinit_stores (declared_global p);
 declared_global p,prog_table p \<turnstile>
 (main_body (prog_table p), s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 (residual, s, frs);
 run_voblint config p = Analysed res;
 \<And>t.
    t \<in> \<T>\<^bsub>declared_global
                         p,prog_cfg
                            p,cinit_stores
                               (declared_global p)\<^esub> \<Longrightarrow>
    \<exists>c.
       activation_context_rel (declared_global p) R c\<^sub>0 (prog_cfg p) t
        c;
 \<And>v.
    \<Union>
     (range
       (\<A>\<^bsub>declared_global
                     p,R,c\<^sub>0,prog_cfg
                                    p,cinit_stores
 (declared_global p)\<^esub>
         v)) =
    \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
                 p,prog_cfg p,cinit_stores (declared_global p)\<^esub>
     v\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>v stk t c.
                     prog_table p,prog_cfg p \<turnstile>
                     (residual, s, frs) \<approx> (v, s, stk) \<and>
                     activation_trace_repr (declared_global p) (prog_cfg p)
                      (cinit_stores (declared_global p)) (v, s, stk)
                      t \<and>
                     activation_context_rel (declared_global p) R c\<^sub>0
                      (prog_cfg p) t c \<and>
                     s \<in> \<A>\<^bsub>declared_global
    p,R,c\<^sub>0,prog_cfg p,cinit_stores (declared_global p)\<^esub>
                              v c \<and>
                     \<Union>
                      (range
                        (\<A>\<^bsub>declared_global
p,R,c\<^sub>0,prog_cfg p,cinit_stores (declared_global p)\<^esub>
                          v)) =
                     \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
                                  p,prog_cfg
                                     p,cinit_stores
  (declared_global p)\<^esub>
                      v \<and>
                     \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
                                  p,prog_cfg
                                     p,cinit_stores
  (declared_global p)\<^esub>
                      v
                     \<subseteq> \<lbrakk>res\<rbrakk>\<^bsub>v\<^esub> \<and>
                     \<lbrakk>res\<rbrakk>\<^bsub>v\<^esub>
                     \<subseteq> \<V>\<^bsub>res\<^esub> v
run_voblint_spine.why: Results chapter: a source run's trace, its context and the chain to the verdicts, once for every policy.

source_progress.statement:
\<lbrakk>wf_source_program \<G> \<Pi>;
 \<G>,\<Pi> \<turnstile>
 (main_body \<Pi>, s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 (c, s, frs)\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> c = SKIP \<and> frs = [] \<or>
                  (\<exists>cfg'.
                      \<G>,\<Pi> \<turnstile>
                      (c, s, frs) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p cfg')
source_progress.why: Program-model chapter: reachable configurations of a well-formed program are finished or can step.

source_reaches_node_collect.statement:

 (residual, s, frs)\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>v stk.
                     Pi,compile_prog Pi ps \<turnstile>
                     (residual, s, frs) \<approx> (v, s, stk) \<and>
                     s \<in> \<C>\<^bsub>\<G>,compile_prog Pi ps,S\<^esub> v

source_run_has_activation_trace.statement:
\<lbrakk>wf_compile_input \<G> \<Pi> ps; s0.0 \<in> S;
 \<G>,\<Pi> \<turnstile>
 (main_body \<Pi>, s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*

\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>v stk t.
                     \<Pi>,compile_prog \<Pi> ps \<turnstile>
